LanguageData.VFEI2_LargeBurrow.description: A massive insectoid-made hole connecting to some unseen cave network deep under the surface. The walls are covered in insectoid goop and are too slippery to climb down. Insectoid chittering can be heard from the tunnels beneath. They will emerge regularly in regular intervals until the burrow collapses or is destroyed. Burrows can only be damaged by explosions.
LanguageData.VFEI2_LargeBurrow.label: large insect burrow
LanguageData.VFEI2_LargeBurrowSpawner.label: tunnel
